title: Unveiling the promise of peptide nucleic acids as functional linkers for an RNA imaging platform
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,249-262
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00274A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aleksandra J. Wierzba, Erin M. Richards, Shelby R. Lennon, Robert T. Batey, Amy E. Palmer
Incorporating a PNA linker into an RNA imaging platform yielded significant improvements in probe affinity and specificity through a dual-binding mechanism: cobalamin-mediated RNA structure recognition and sequence-specific PNA–RNA interaction.
